name: 0.5 existence-proof hunt (ROADMAP 0.5): third-party quants, GGUF + compressed-tensors strata (tier A subset, 2026-08-18)

targets.name: gguf-gemma3-270m-lmstudio
targets.notes: TIER A, run first: cheapest pair (0.80 GB), 4th quantizer org, smoke-test for the pinned binary. Gemma terms govern redistribution of derived outputs. Curation facts: screens/targets-0.5.curation.json

targets.name: gguf-llama32-1b-bartowski
targets.notes: TIER A: cheapest mainstream llama pair (3.29 GB), 227,693 30d downloads. Llama 3.2 Community License; GGUF repo ungated.

targets.name: gguf-qwen25-15b-uncensored-mradermacher
targets.notes: TIER A: 3rd quantizer pipeline, and the most safety-informative base — an already-de-aligned fine-tune is where a quantization-conditional refusal shift is most likely measurable. 4.68 GB. No license on the quantizer card; provenance flagged in curation file.

targets.name: gguf-r1-distill-qwen-15b-unsloth
targets.notes: TIER A: direct tie to the R1-1776 8-bit re-censorship incident class (ROADMAP outreach). 4.68 GB. apache-2.0 on the GGUF repo; MIT on the DeepSeek base; both ungated.

targets.name: gguf-lfm25-12b-unsloth
targets.notes: TIER A: architectural outlier (hybrid conv/attention) exercising different llama.cpp quantization kernels. 3.07 GB. LiquidAI LFM Open License ('other') — read before redistributing completions.
